2: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Jehovah, how many are they that trouble me, many they that rise up against me!
3: Many say of my soul, There is no salvation for him inGod. Selah.
4: But thou, Jehovah, art a shield about me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
5: With my voice will I call to Jehovah, and he will answer me from the hill of his holiness. Selah.
6: I laid me down and slept; I awaked, for Jehovah sustaineth me.
7: I will not fear for myriads of the people that have set themselves against me round about.
8: Arise, Jehovah; save me, myGod! For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheekbone, thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
9: Salvation is of Jehovah; thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
